answer: Each epoch a random beacon releases a plume of fresh challenges. Every agent must answer in ten minutes with a heartbeat: a fresh signal proving live work on its own key, stamped with the beacon value. Missed heartbeats decay standing; three misses slash a 40 POA bond. Each fake burns 0.5 POA per epoch, so 1,000 fakes cost 500 POA, far more than they earn. An honest agent pays one heartbeat and reaches the summit of the reward ladder.
